key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:09BA
name: store_record_fields_into_slot
description: Calls a test routine and, when it returns zero, calls five helper routines and then copies three 16-bit words from the argument record (offsets 2, 4 and 6) into one slot of two tables. The slot index comes from a global index shifted, masked and multiplied by eight.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:0A0E
name: integrate_motion_and_retire
description: Increments a counter field of the object record up to its limit, then integrates two position-like fields and a speed-like field from table lookups, scaled by a shift and divided by a global divisor. It decrements a timer field and runs a test routine; if the object is finished it saves its words into globals, sets a status variable to minus three and returns minus one, otherwise it returns zero.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:0A20
name: select_nearest_candidate_and_advance
description: When a status field of the record is negative, scans a list of candidates and keeps the one with the smallest measured distance, storing its record pointer. It then applies a motion step with a decaying speed field and table-driven position updates, decrements the timer field and returns zero or minus one depending on the test routine.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:0A6E
name: copy_record_words_double_test
description: Runs a test routine, then a second test if the first passes; when both succeed it calls five helper routines and copies three 16-bit words from the argument record into three global variables.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:0A78
name: step_motion_with_speed_decay
description: Tests the record and either copies its words to globals or, when the test fails, reduces a speed field by a fixed quotient if positive, raises a counter field up to its limit, integrates two position fields from table lookups, and decrements the timer. It returns minus one after saving the record, or zero when the object is still active.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:0AB0
name: copy_record_words_after_test
description: Runs a single test routine and, when it returns zero, calls five helper routines and copies three 16-bit words from the argument record into three global variables.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:0B0A
name: clamp_axis_step_from_record
description: Computes the difference between a target value and a record field, clamps it to a limit stored in the record, and applies it to two position fields. If a test succeeds and the magnitude of an offset field plus a bound stays within a limit, it saves the record words to globals, sets a status variable to eight and returns minus one.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:0B1C
name: clamp_axis_step_from_registers
description: Performs the same clamped difference step as its record-based sibling, but takes its inputs from processor registers instead of record fields. It applies the step to the position fields and saves the record words and a status of eight to globals when the test and bound check both pass.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:0B58
name: apply_offset_step_with_bound
description: Applies a scaled step to an offset field and calls a test routine. If the test passes and the absolute value of a second offset plus a limit field is within the bound, it saves the record words to globals, sets a status variable to eight and returns minus one; otherwise it returns zero.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:0B7A
name: save_record_if_within_bound
description: Takes the absolute value of an offset and checks that it plus a limit stays within a bound derived from a record field. When it does, it zeroes the first word of the record, saves three words to globals, sets a status variable to eight and returns minus one.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:0BC0
name: call_record_handler_pointer
description: Loads the code pointer stored at offset 16 of the argument record and calls it. It is a one-line dispatch stub; the referenced routine is only known through the pointer.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:0BC6
name: advance_motion_and_queue_event
description: Runs a handler through a code pointer stored in the record, and when the handler reports success it steps the record position with the table-driven update used elsewhere, saves three words to globals and appends a six-byte entry with type eight to a list when there is space. The routine references the text HIT BY, and it returns eight after queueing the entry.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:0D72
name: decay_speed_and_integrate_motion
description: Reduces a speed field toward zero by a fixed quotient when it is positive, raises a counter field up to its limit, and integrates two position fields from table lookups. It decrements a timer field, runs a test routine and returns minus one after saving the record words when the test fails, or zero when it passes.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:0D8A
name: integrate_motion_and_retire
description: Increments a counter field up to its limit, integrates two position fields and a speed field from table lookups scaled by a shift and a divisor, and decrements a timer field. It then tests the object and either returns zero or saves its words to globals, sets a status variable to minus three and returns minus one.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:0EC2
name: check_window_and_set_mode
description: Sets a mode field to ten. When a global flag is clear and the absolute difference between the record's position field and a reference value is below a window size, it returns minus one and sets the mode to three, and when a second, closer window also matches it writes a value into a handler pointer.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:0F04
name: check_offset_band_set_mode
description: Sets a mode field to ten. When a global flag is clear and the offset from a reference value, reduced by a fixed amount, lies outside a band derived from a global scale, it returns minus one and sets the mode to thirteen; a closer check then writes a value into a handler pointer.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:0F5A
name: check_offset_band_no_flag
description: Sets a mode field to ten and tests whether the offset from a reference value, reduced by a fixed amount, lies outside a band derived from a global scale. When it does it returns minus one and sets the mode to four, and a closer check writes a value into a handler pointer.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:0FA8
name: arm_record_handler_once
description: If a flag bit in the record is not yet set, it sets that bit and installs this routine as the record's handler, copies three words to globals, calls helper routines and checks a global. When the check passes it writes a value into a handler pointer, sets a pending global to minus one and returns zero; if the flag bit was already set it returns minus one.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:103E
name: activate_slot_record
description: Returns minus one if the record's high flag bit is already set. Otherwise it marks the record active, clears a field, and links it into one of two global slots depending on which slot pointer matches. It then calls helpers, updates a state variable and calls a further helper when a slot count is below two.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:1168
name: advance_idle_counter_timer
description: When a global flag is zero, it adds one to a counter global, calls a helper routine and sets a timer global to fourteen. It does nothing when the flag is set.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:118E
name: test_target_distance_window
description: If the argument reaches a threshold computed from record field 8 times four, it tests whether the absolute difference between record field 10 and a global reference, offset by a constant, is below a bound built from globals. It returns zero when the test passes and minus one otherwise.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:11AC
name: check_position_offset_window
description: Tests whether the absolute difference between record field 10 and a global reference, offset by a constant, is below a bound built from globals. It returns zero when it is and minus one otherwise.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:11D6
name: check_position_beyond_threshold
description: If the argument reaches a threshold from record field 8, it returns zero when the absolute difference between record field 10 and a global reference exceeds 8192; otherwise it returns minus one.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:11F4
name: check_offset_beyond_limit
description: Returns zero when the absolute difference between record field 10 and a global reference exceeds 8192, and minus one otherwise.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:120A
name: update_record_timers_in_table
description: Walks a table of fifty-byte records whose count comes from a global. Active records have their countdown field decremented, and when it expires it is reloaded from a global divider and the record's field 10; at a countdown of four, with a negative global, a helper is called and a flag bit is set, while inactive records have a flag bit cleared.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:1280
name: spawn_record_into_free_slot
description: Derives a mode code of ten, eleven or three from a distance value, then copies the record's position and state into globals and updates flag and counter fields. When several thresholds on globals and record fields are met, it fills a free slot in a table of records with the new entry, increments a count global and calls helper routines; the referenced text FIRING suggests the entry is a fired shot.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:146A
name: compute_record_weight_value
description: For a record whose field 8 is neither zero nor minus one, returns a product of a sum of two record fields and a global speed term, shifted and scaled by a global counter; returns zero otherwise.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:14B6
name: run_record_handler_table
description: Saves the previous handler count, then walks the record table, eighty-six bytes apart, calling the handler pointer stored at offset 32 of each record and counting the calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:14E8
name: pick_nearest_eligible_record
description: When a count and a range comparison hold, scans fifty-byte records whose flag pattern is set and calls a distance helper for each, keeping the one with the smallest result. When one is found it stores a frame value and calls two helper routines.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:1576
name: integrate_motion_and_spawn
description: Ramps a field toward a threshold, integrates position and speed fields from table lookups, and decrements a counter that triggers handler and nearest-record selection when it reaches zero. It then runs the spawn check and copies the record into a free table slot when the frame and range conditions hold.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:15DE
name: move_toward_target_and_spawn
description: Computes the distance from a target record and arms a handler with zeroed motion fields when the target is close. Otherwise it integrates the motion fields from table lookups, decrements a counter, selects the nearest eligible record and runs the spawn check.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:1678
name: decelerate_motion_and_spawn
description: Reduces a speed-like field toward zero, or installs handler pointers when it is already zero. It then integrates motion from table lookups, decrements a counter, selects the nearest eligible record and runs the spawn check.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:169A
name: integrate_motion_at_table_end
description: Clears a flag bit and, when the table index is at or past the count minus four, installs handler pointers and integrates motion from table lookups. It then runs the nearest-record selection and the spawn check.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:16B6
name: integrate_motion_with_handlers
description: Clears a flag bit, restores the saved handler when a field is clear, integrates position and speed fields from table lookups and decrements a counter. It then runs the nearest-record selection and the spawn check.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:16D0
name: ramp_speed_and_integrate_motion
description: Sets a speed field to zero, raises a second field by a fixed amount when a position field is small, and ramps a timing field toward a threshold. It then integrates motion from table lookups, decrements a counter, selects the nearest eligible record and runs the spawn check.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:16DE
name: integrate_motion_with_speed_ramp
description: Ramps a timing field toward a threshold and restores the saved handler when it is reached, then integrates motion from table lookups and decrements a counter. It finishes with the nearest-record selection and the spawn check.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:1708
name: restore_handler_and_integrate_motion
description: Clears a flag bit and restores the saved handler pointer, then integrates motion from table lookups, decrements a counter and runs nearest-record selection and the spawn check.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:1718
name: project_record_position_to_globals
description: Advances a frame-counter global and, when the record is within a near window, recomputes a set of coordinate globals from table lookups using the record's position and angle fields. Otherwise it chooses a direction value from a flag-controlled table, then integrates motion and runs the spawn check; the listing is truncated before the end.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:1904
name: integrate_motion_from_argument_value
description: Takes a value from an argument word: when it equals 512 it uses a constant with an offset from a record field, otherwise it shifts the argument left by twelve bits. It clamps the result against a limit, integrates motion from table lookups and runs the spawn check.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:1940
name: integrate_motion_from_scaled_argument
description: Shifts an argument word left by twelve bits, clamps the result against a limit, integrates position and speed fields from table lookups, decrements a counter and runs the nearest-record selection and the spawn check.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:1960
name: integrate_motion_with_candidate_search
description: When a flag bit is clear and a masked frame value is zero, it scans up to eight candidates and stops at the first one within a distance limit. It then advances a timer field, arms a handler, integrates motion from table lookups and runs the nearest-record selection and spawn check.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:197C
name: retire_far_object_and_integrate
description: Runs the same candidate search gate and, when the object is beyond a distance limit, installs a new handler, clears flag bits and zeroes a field, then returns. Otherwise it scans candidates, advances the timer, integrates motion from table lookups and runs the nearest-record selection and spawn check.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:1A14
name: search_candidates_for_close_match
description: Loops over up to a count of candidate records, comparing each against two distance thresholds and storing the pointer of the one that qualifies. It then arms a handler, integrates motion from table lookups and runs the nearest-record selection and spawn check.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:1A1E
name: reset_record_handler_and_flags
description: Installs a new code pointer at offset 32 of the record, clears most flag bits in the word at offset 24 by masking, and zeroes the word at offset 44.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:1A32
name: compute_scaled_offset_from_record
description: Calls three helper routines and returns the difference between an argument position and the record's field 4, shifted right by five bits as a scaled offset.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:1A6A
name: stub_no_operation
description: The routine body is a bare return with no work, so it is an empty placeholder with no behaviour to describe.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:1A7A
name: integrate_motion_toward_argument_target
description: Clamps the difference between an argument position and the record's position field to the record's speed limit, then integrates position, velocity and angle fields from table lookups. It finishes with the nearest-record selection and the spawn check.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:1A88
name: integrate_motion_toward_offset_target
description: Clamps a position difference like its neighbour, integrates motion from table lookups and runs the nearest-record selection and the spawn check.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:1A98
name: integrate_motion_with_bounded_step
description: Clamps the argument against the negated second argument, computes a speed step from the record's speed limit and integrates motion from table lookups. It then runs the nearest-record selection and the spawn check.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:1AB0
name: integrate_motion_with_bounded_speed
description: Clamps the argument against the negated second argument, updates the angle field from a difference, integrates motion from table lookups and runs the nearest-record selection and the spawn check.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:1AF0
name: integrate_motion_with_fire_check
description: Clamps and steps the angle field, integrates motion from table lookups and then runs the nearest-record selection and spawn check. The routine is long and also references the text fired by, which the listing shows only in part.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:1E7E
name: expire_and_store_record
description: When a record's counter is below one, clears its flag bits and installs an expiry handler. It sets a status variable to minus eight, copies the record into a table slot on frames that are a multiple of four, and integrates motion from table lookups with the nearest-record selection and spawn check.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:1F02
name: initialize_record_from_source
description: Sets a horizontal field from the sign of a global and copies position and velocity fields from a source record, using offsets chosen by a flag bit in the source. It sets state fields, installs the update handler and, when the record lies inside the table, calls five helper routines; the routine references the text taking off.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:1FFA
name: update_frame_timing_and_counters
description: Clamps a global divider between four and fifteen and halves it when a flag is set, then derives two timing globals from it. It runs eight helper routines, decrements a countdown, advances the frame counter, calls helpers every 8 and every 128 frames, and sets a timer global to 5000 and a status global to 255 when a countdown expires.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:20D4
name: decrement_two_global_timers
description: Decrements two global countdown variables by one each when they are nonzero. It returns the unchanged return register and does nothing when both are zero.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][m goonies][t +4 metal force]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][m Goonies][t +4 Metal Force].adf:game:0:20D8
name: decrement_two_global_timers
description: Decrements the same two global countdown variables by one each when they are nonzero, with no return value.
